cases.title: The battery nobody mentioned
cases.setup: You sell a used laptop. It works on a charger, but the battery lasts only ten minutes.
facts: You know about the battery.
The listing says “works well.”

choices.label: Describe the battery before taking payment.
choices.consequence: The buyer can assess the actual condition.

choices.label: Wait to see whether the buyer asks.
choices.consequence: The buyer may rely on a description you know is incomplete.

choices.label: Pause the sale and test the laptop again.
choices.consequence: A second test can clarify the description, provided you do not conceal what is already known.

cases.followup: The buyer asks you to put the condition in the receipt.

repairs.label: Record the known defect and agreed price.
repairs.consequence: Both sides keep a clear record of what was disclosed.

repairs.label: Write “sold as seen” and omit the known defect.
repairs.consequence: A general phrase does not explain the concealed battery condition.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَأْكُلُوٓا۟ أَمْوَٰلَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنكُمْ ۚ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Squander not your wealth among yourselves in vanity, except it be a trade by mutual consent, and kill not one another. Lo! Allah is ever Merciful unto you.

cases.teaching: Al-Muyassar explains trade by mutual consent rather than wrongful taking. Applying that principle to this laptop is an editorial exercise.

sources.label: Sahih al-Bukhari 2079
sources.note: Hakim ibn Hizam’s report links honest disclosure with blessing in a transaction.

cases.title: The underfilled spice packet
cases.setup: Your 500 g packets contain 470 g. A colleague says the difference is too small to matter.
facts: The scale was checked.
The label still promises 500 g.

choices.label: Correct the weight or the label before selling.
choices.consequence: The advertised and delivered quantities can agree.

choices.label: Keep the label because most buyers will not weigh it.
choices.consequence: Customers receive less than the stated quantity.

choices.label: Stop sales while checking the affected batch.
choices.consequence: You avoid repeating an uncertain measurement.

cases.followup: Some underfilled packets have already been sold.

repairs.label: Identify the affected sales and offer a clear remedy.
repairs.consequence: Customers can receive the missing quantity or an agreed correction.

repairs.label: Fix future packets but ignore the earlier shortage.
repairs.consequence: The earlier customers still bear the known shortfall.

passage.arabic:
وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
passage.translation:
Woe unto the defrauders:
Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,
But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.

cases.teaching: Al-Muyassar describes the contrast between demanding full measure and giving others less. The packet and remedy are fictional applications.

cases.title: The delivery date that changed
cases.setup: Your workshop accepted an order due Friday. A larger client now wants the same production slot.
facts: The first customer agreed to Friday.
No revised date has been accepted.

choices.label: Keep the agreed slot or seek a genuine revision.
choices.consequence: The customer can decide whether a new date is acceptable.

choices.label: Move the first order and notify them afterward.
choices.consequence: You change a material promise without agreement.

choices.label: Check capacity before accepting the second order.
choices.consequence: You can avoid making incompatible promises.

repairs.label: Explain promptly and discuss a remedy.
repairs.consequence: The customer can make an informed choice about the delay.

repairs.label: Give repeated reassuring updates without a realistic date.
repairs.consequence: Reassurance hides the unresolved delivery problem.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعُقُودِ ۚ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُم بَهِيمَةُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّى ٱلصَّيْدِ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Fulfil your indentures. The beast of cattle is made lawful unto you (for food) except that which is announced unto you (herein), game being unlawful when ye are on the pilgrimage. Lo! Allah ordaineth that which pleaseth Him.

cases.teaching: Al-Muyassar includes people’s agreements and transactions in its explanation of fulfilling commitments. Contract remedies here are learning suggestions, not rulings.

cases.title: A completed job and an unpaid invoice
cases.setup: A freelancer completed the agreed work. Your company can pay but wants to retain cash for another purchase.
facts: The work met the agreed scope.
The agreed payment is due.

choices.label: Pay on the agreed terms.
choices.consequence: The worker receives the compensation already earned.

choices.label: Delay because the freelancer is unlikely to complain.
choices.consequence: You retain another person’s due payment for your convenience.

choices.label: Check the invoice against the agreement today.
choices.consequence: A genuine check can clarify an error without becoming an indefinite delay.

cases.followup: The accounts team proposes another month of delay.

repairs.label: Resolve any real discrepancy and release the due payment.
repairs.consequence: A specific accounting issue is separated from avoidance.

repairs.label: Ask the worker to keep waiting without a reason.
repairs.consequence: The same unpaid obligation continues.

passage.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْإِحْسَـٰنِ وَإِيتَآئِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْبَغْىِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
passage.translation: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed.

cases.teaching: Al-Muyassar describes justice as giving people their due. This case applies that teaching to a fictional completed job.

sources.label: Sahih al-Bukhari 2270
sources.note: Abu Hurayra’s report includes taking a worker’s full labor without paying the wage.

cases.title: When a customer genuinely cannot pay
cases.setup: A customer with an outstanding debt lost their income and explains that they cannot currently repay.
facts: The debt is acknowledged.
The difficulty is genuine in this fictional case.

choices.label: Discuss time and an achievable repayment arrangement.
choices.consequence: You respond to the stated hardship rather than pretending it does not exist.

choices.label: Threaten public humiliation to force immediate payment.
choices.consequence: Pressure does not create money the customer does not have.

choices.label: Clarify the situation respectfully before agreeing details.
choices.consequence: Both sides can understand what is possible.

cases.followup: You can afford to forgive part of the debt.

repairs.label: Consider remission without turning it into publicity.
repairs.consequence: You can reduce the debt while preserving the customer’s dignity.

repairs.label: Offer remission only if they post a promotional testimonial.
repairs.consequence: The proposed help becomes pressure for a marketing benefit.

passage.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ ذُو عُسْرَةٍ فَنَظِرَةٌ إِلَىٰ مَيْسَرَةٍ ۚ وَأَن تَصَدَّقُوا۟ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
passage.translation: And if the debtor is in straitened circumstances, then (let there be) postponement to (the time of) ease; and that ye remit the debt as almsgiving would be better for you if ye did but know.

cases.teaching: Al-Muyassar explains giving an insolvent debtor time, and describes remission as better. Practical arrangements in this case are editorial examples.

cases.title: Delay by a customer who can pay
cases.setup: Your shop has funds to settle a due supplier invoice, but delaying would improve this month’s cash balance.
facts: The invoice is due and undisputed.
The shop has enough funds.

choices.label: Settle the due invoice.
choices.consequence: The supplier receives payment according to the agreement.

choices.label: Delay until the supplier threatens action.
choices.consequence: You use avoidable delay as a negotiating tactic.

choices.label: Check the exact due date and amount now.
choices.consequence: You can resolve uncertainty before deciding.

cases.followup: A colleague confuses this with genuine financial hardship.

repairs.label: Distinguish inability from a convenient delay.
repairs.consequence: The actual facts stay central to the decision.

repairs.label: Claim that every delayed payment is hardship.
repairs.consequence: The label conceals the shop’s ability to pay.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعُقُودِ ۚ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُم بَهِيمَةُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّى ٱلصَّيْدِ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Fulfil your indentures. The beast of cattle is made lawful unto you (for food) except that which is announced unto you (herein), game being unlawful when ye are on the pilgrimage. Lo! Allah ordaineth that which pleaseth Him.

cases.teaching: The commitment reading is paired with a specific report about avoidable delay. Do not equate wealth with freedom from obligations.

sources.label: Sahih al-Bukhari 2400
sources.note: Abu Hurayra’s report identifies delay in repayment by an able debtor as injustice.

cases.title: The friendly loan with no record
cases.setup: Two friends agree on a deferred loan, then remember different amounts and due dates.
facts: Repayment is deferred.
The amount and date were never recorded.

choices.label: Agree on a clear written record together.
choices.consequence: Both parties can check the same terms.

choices.label: Treat asking for a record as an insult.
choices.consequence: The disagreement remains unresolved.

choices.label: Pause and clarify what each person actually agreed.
choices.consequence: You avoid recording an amount one party disputes.

cases.followup: A draft contains the wrong amount.

repairs.label: Correct it before either person accepts it.
repairs.consequence: The document reflects the actual agreement.

repairs.label: Leave it because a signature matters more than accuracy.
repairs.consequence: The record preserves a known error.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ ۚ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًٔا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ ۖ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَـٰدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ ۖ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا ۗ وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ ۚ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! When ye contract a debt for a fixed term, record it in writing. Let a scribe record it in writing between you in (terms of) equity. No scribe should refuse to write as Allah hath taught him, so let him write, and let him who incurreth the debt dictate, and let him observe his duty to Allah his Lord, and diminish naught thereof. But if he who oweth the debt is of low understanding, or weak, or unable himself to dictate, then let the guardian of his interests dictate in (terms of) equity. And call to witness, from among your men, two witnesses. And if two men be not (at hand) then a man and two women, of such as ye approve as witnesses, so that if the one erreth (through forgetfulness) the other will remember. And the witnesses must not refuse when they are summoned. Be not averse to writing down (the contract) whether it be small or great, with (record of) the term thereof. That is more equitable in the sight of Allah and more sure for testimony, and the best way of avoiding doubt between you; save only in the case when it is actual merchandise which ye transfer among yourselves from hand to hand. In that case it is no sin for you if ye write it not. And have witnesses when ye sell one to another, and let no harm be done to scribe or witness. If ye do (harm to them) lo! it is a sin in you. Observe your duty to Allah. Allah is teaching you. And Allah is knower of all things.

cases.teaching: Al-Muyassar explains recording a deferred debt to preserve rights and avoid dispute. This short activity does not replace the verse’s full discussion of writing and witnesses.

cases.title: Whose money is the deposit?
cases.setup: A client leaves funds with you to buy materials for their project. You consider using the money temporarily for your own order.
facts: The money was entrusted for a stated purchase.
The client has not authorized another use.

choices.label: Keep the funds for their agreed purpose.
choices.consequence: The client’s entrusted money stays available.

choices.label: Use it and hope to replace it before anyone notices.
choices.consequence: You change the use without the owner’s knowledge.

choices.label: Ask about any proposed change before acting.
choices.consequence: The owner can accept or refuse with the facts in view.

cases.followup: The client requests an account of the spending.

repairs.label: Provide an accurate record and return any balance.
repairs.consequence: The owner can inspect what happened to their funds.

repairs.label: Invent receipts to conceal a temporary diversion.
repairs.consequence: A false record adds concealment to the original problem.

passage.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تُؤَدُّوا۟ ٱلْأَمَـٰنَـٰتِ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا وَإِذَا حَكَمْتُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ أَن تَحْكُمُوا۟ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُم بِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
passage.translation: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye restore deposits to their owners, and, if ye judge between mankind, that ye judge justly. Lo! comely is this which Allah admonisheth you. Lo! Allah is ever Hearer, Seer.

cases.teaching: Al-Muyassar explains returning entrusted things to their owners. The deposit scenario is an editorial application, not a ruling on a real contract.

cases.title: The recommendation with a hidden incentive
cases.setup: You recommend a supplier as independent advice while receiving a referral fee if the customer chooses them.
facts: The customer thinks the comparison is independent.
You have a financial incentive.

choices.label: Explain the incentive before the recommendation.
choices.consequence: The customer can evaluate the advice with that fact in view.

choices.label: Keep the incentive secret because the product is decent.
choices.consequence: The customer cannot assess the conflict you know about.

choices.label: Offer a comparison without pretending neutrality.
choices.consequence: The recommendation’s basis can be made clear.

cases.followup: The supplier asks you to claim there is no commission.

repairs.label: Decline the false statement and correct any misleading description.
repairs.consequence: The customer receives an honest account.

repairs.label: Use the supplier’s wording despite knowing it is false.
repairs.consequence: The recommendation now includes a direct falsehood.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَأْكُلُوٓا۟ أَمْوَٰلَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنكُمْ ۚ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Squander not your wealth among yourselves in vanity, except it be a trade by mutual consent, and kill not one another. Lo! Allah is ever Merciful unto you.

cases.teaching: Al-Muyassar explains lawful trade by consent and rejects wrongful taking. Disclosure of this fictional incentive is applied reasoning beyond the fetched text.

sources.label: Sahih al-Bukhari 2079
sources.note: The report stresses truth and disclosure in a transaction; it does not define every modern referral arrangement.

cases.title: A repair hidden under fresh paint
cases.setup: A cabinet has structural damage. Fresh paint makes it look new in photographs.
facts: The damage affects use.
The buyer cannot see it in the photos.

choices.label: Show the damaged area and describe the repair.
choices.consequence: The buyer can judge the actual item.

choices.label: Photograph only the undamaged side.
choices.consequence: The presentation conceals a material fact.

choices.label: Have the structure checked before listing it.
choices.consequence: You can learn what is safe to claim.

cases.followup: The buyer asks whether it is structurally sound.

repairs.label: Answer according to the inspection and known limits.
repairs.consequence: You avoid promising more than the evidence supports.

repairs.label: Say “perfect” to finish the sale.
repairs.consequence: The answer hides an unresolved defect.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَأْكُلُوٓا۟ أَمْوَٰلَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنكُمْ ۚ وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Squander not your wealth among yourselves in vanity, except it be a trade by mutual consent, and kill not one another. Lo! Allah is ever Merciful unto you.

cases.teaching: The consent reading provides the wider ethical setting. The cabinet is a modern fictional application.

sources.label: Sahih Muslim 102
sources.note: Abu Hurayra’s report describes concealed wet food and the need to make its condition visible.

cases.title: The fee revealed after agreement
cases.setup: A customer agrees to a quoted total. At collection, you add a mandatory fee that was already known to you.
facts: The fee was foreseeable.
The customer relied on the quoted total.

choices.label: Explain the complete price before agreement.
choices.consequence: The customer can decide with the total visible.

choices.label: Reveal the fee only after the work is finished.
choices.consequence: The customer faces a cost they were not able to evaluate.

choices.label: Clarify what the original quote actually included.
choices.consequence: You can distinguish a real change in scope from an undisclosed charge.

cases.followup: The customer challenges the extra fee.

repairs.label: Review the agreement and seek a transparent resolution.
repairs.consequence: The disputed term can be discussed using the original record.

repairs.label: Insist that small print need never be explained.
repairs.consequence: The foreseeable misunderstanding remains unresolved.

passage.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعُقُودِ ۚ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُم بَهِيمَةُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّى ٱلصَّيْدِ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ
passage.translation: O ye who believe! Fulfil your indentures. The beast of cattle is made lawful unto you (for food) except that which is announced unto you (herein), game being unlawful when ye are on the pilgrimage. Lo! Allah ordaineth that which pleaseth Him.

cases.teaching: Al-Muyassar includes transactions in fulfilling agreements. The example addresses clarity, not a universal rule about every pricing structure.

cases.title: A review from someone who never bought
cases.setup: A friend offers to post a glowing customer review without buying or using the service.
facts: No customer experience took place.
Readers will think the review is independent.

choices.label: Ask for genuine feedback from actual users.
choices.consequence: A testimonial can describe a real experience.

choices.label: Accept the invented review to help the launch.
choices.consequence: Readers receive a false account.

choices.label: Invite the friend to test the service and disclose the relationship.
choices.consequence: Any later account can state what actually happened.

cases.followup: An invented review is already live.

repairs.label: Correct or remove the misleading review.
repairs.consequence: Future readers can avoid relying on a fabricated experience.

repairs.label: Leave it because no one can prove the reviewer was not a customer.
repairs.consequence: The misleading account remains available.

passage.arabic: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًا
passage.translation: (O man), follow not that whereof thou hast no knowledge. Lo! the hearing and the sight and the heart - of each of these it will be asked.

cases.teaching: Al-Muyassar calls for checking what one does not know. Applying that reading to testimonials is editorial reasoning.

sources.label: Sahih al-Bukhari 6094
sources.note: The report connects persistent truthfulness with righteousness and warns about lying.

methodology: Twelve fictional two-stage dilemmas connect a source reading with an explicitly editorial modern application. Outcomes are written possibilities, not promised worldly results or judgments of a person. Canonical Quran text and Pickthall wording come from Quran MCP; Al-Muyassar provides concise explanation and Al-Qurtubi is linked for further legal discussion where fetched. Hadith notes are original paraphrases of specifically identified reports. The exercises do not certify a real transaction as halal, replace a qualified adviser or supply legal/financial advice.
